name: Whirlwind Kick
author: voodoo573
description:
Level 3 transmutation spell from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. You must be able to move in order to cast this spell. You leap into the air and spin like a tornado, striking foes all around you with supernatural force as you fly up to 60 feet in a straight line. Your movement (which does not provoke attacks of opportunity) must end on a surface that can support your weight or you fall as normal.

As part of the casting of this spell, make a melee spell attack against any number of creatures in the area. On a hit, you deal your unarmed strike damage plus 2d6 thunder damage. In addition, creatures in the area make a Dexterity saving throw or are either pulled 10 feet closer to you or pushed 10 feet away (your choice).
summary: 3rd-level: spin through a 60-ft line, striking every foe for unarmed damage plus 2d6 thunder.

data.name: Whirlwind Kick
data.desc:
Area: a line up to 60 feet long and 15 feet wide. You must be able to move in order to cast this spell. You leap into the air and spin like a tornado, striking foes all around you with supernatural force as you fly up to 60 feet in a straight line. Your movement (which does not provoke attacks of opportunity) must end on a surface that can support your weight or you fall as normal.

As part of the casting of this spell, make a melee spell attack against any number of creatures in the area. On a hit, you deal your unarmed strike damage plus 2d6 thunder damage. In addition, creatures in the area make a Dexterity saving throw or are either pulled 10 feet closer to you or pushed 10 feet away (your choice).

At higher levels: The extra thunder damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

Hearth note: the dice shown are the extra thunder damage; add your unarmed strike damage on a hit and handle the Dexterity save (pull or push 10 feet) by hand.
